title: Had a Blast!!!
text: Eduardo was wonderful! Being hands on with the cooking experience and sangria making was EXACTLY what we were looking for! The friendly competition of making the best paella between three groups was a nice bonus. Not only was it a cooking class, it brought many people together that have never met and made connections you never thought you would! Highly recommend! We had a blast!!

title: Paula is great!
text: Paula was a great chef. I learned a lot of new skills that I will take to my own kitchen from her. Please go if you get the chance.

author: Z7863CNvictoriar

title: More than just a cooking class!
text:
Went with friends and ended up cooking with people from all over the world, such a vibe! This isn't your typical cooking class, it's a real experience. The chef and hosts are super fun and welcoming, you learn actual techniques (finally nailed the sofrito!), and the whole thing just flows super natural.
Sangria, laughs, and at the end we ate the most delicious paella we'd made ourselves. They make you feel right at home. A must-do in Barcelona!
author: 304elisabetv

title: Fantastic experience
text: Unbeatable experience! I went with my partner and we both loved it! Both the cook and the other boy were super nice, making the activity very dynamic and collaborative among the members of the group. We prepared very rich tapas and the paella was very good, pity that I did not take a picture.  By the way, the space very cool, looking forward to coming back!

title: Fun cooking
text: A great activity with a super lovely team. Looking forward to coming back to make a potato tortilla as good as paella. 100% recommended.
